prompt:
You are a senior information designer and editorial typographer who sets data tables for high-quality publications (statistical yearbooks, reference works, financial reports, technical documentation) in many writing systems, including Chinese. You judge by looking at the real rendered result.

Judge a table layout on all of these levels, in this order of necessity but as one whole:
1. correctness — every character visible, structure intact, nothing clipped or overlapping;
2. readability — natural line breaks, words/numbers/identifiers/semantic units kept whole, continuous reading;
3. function — easy to look up, compare, locate and understand the information for this table's real reading tasks;
4. visual order — alignment, grouping, hierarchy, consistent scale for elements with the same role;
5. visual rhythm — proportion, density changes, distribution of white space, spatial relationships;
6. overall aesthetics — balance, restraint, naturalness, harmony.
Do not assume that equal widths, symmetry, minimum height, the fewest lines, the golden ratio or any fixed proportion is good in itself; decide from this table's function, content and reading task, and look for counter-examples to your own rules.

Table: SaaS服务合同新旧条款对照表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 6 rows. Row headers: yes.
Measured content facts (text px at 15px font, padding excluded):
  col 1: header "条款号" · longest unbreakable unit 31px · widest one-line content 62px
  col 2: header "原文" · longest unbreakable unit 31px · widest one-line content 1563px
  col 3: header "修订后" · longest unbreakable unit 31px · widest one-line content 3232px
  col 4: header "修订说明" · longest unbreakable unit 35px · widest one-line content 1425px
Each column adds 21px of padding+border to its text width.
Viewport: 360px wide (dashed pink box in the renders). The table, including its 1px outer border, must be at most 360px wide (column widths sum to at most 359px); no horizontal scrolling. A table exactly 360px wide fits.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. Only the column widths are designed; row heights follow from them.

Your understanding: {"purpose":"帮助读者按条款号查阅 SaaS 服务合同的原文、修订后文本及修订说明，理解具体变化。","tasks":["按条款号定位需要查阅的条款。","逐行对照原文和修订后文本，识别措辞及义务的变化。","阅读修订说明，理解变化的原因或影响。","连续阅读某一条款的完整内容，必要时继续查阅其他条款。"],"relations":["同一行的原文、修订后文本和修订说明共同对应左侧条款号。","原文与修订后文本是并列比较对象；修订说明辅助解释二者的差异。","各条款相互独立，但共享同一套列标题。"],"roles":["首行标识条款号、原文、修订后和修订说明四种信息。","首列是行标题和查找索引，内容较短。","第二、三列承载需要逐项比较的合同正文，其中修订后文本最长。","第四列承载解释性文字，也可能较长。"],"keep_whole":["条款号及其中的数字、标点。","金额、日期、百分比、编号和合同中有意义的专有名称等语义单元。","列标题宜保持完整，以便在窄屏上辨认。"],"may_wrap":["合同正文和修订说明可按中文自然断行，尽量避免拆散有意义的词语和数字。"],"same_scale":["原文与修订后文本承担并列比较任务，宜保持相近的可读尺度；若更重视阅读较长的修订后文本，也可适度拉开宽度。","同一列中的各条款应使用一致的宽度和视觉尺度。"],"h_vs_v":"360px 内必须同时容纳四列，正文不可避免地会多行换行并形成较高的行；增加某一正文列的宽度会压缩其他列，因此应根据逐项比较、阅读修订文本或查看说明的优先级分配空间。"}

Image 1 is the one-line content overview. Then real browser renders of: d1r2A, d1r2B, d1r1A.
Measured facts:
d1r2A: column widths [83, 79, 116, 81] px · table 360×3962 px · row heights [60, 827, 687, 804, 850, 734] · column headers on >1 line: 1/4 · tallest cell 36 lines · measured breaks inside a word: 160 · fits the 360 px viewport (no scrolling)
d1r2B: column widths [83, 85, 110, 81] px · table 360×4287 px · row heights [60, 687, 734, 943, 1013, 850] · column headers on >1 line: 1/4 · tallest cell 43 lines · measured breaks inside a word: 168 · fits the 360 px viewport (no scrolling)
d1r1A: column widths [68, 95, 113, 83] px · table 360×3636 px · row heights [36, 618, 594, 804, 850, 734] · column headers on >1 line: 0/4 · tallest cell 36 lines · measured breaks inside a word: 134 · fits the 360 px viewport (no scrolling)

Look at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design: what works, what is visually wrong, and the cause (which width). Then either propose up to 3 improved designs (refine the most promising, fix what you saw, or try an important unexplored idea) or, if further changes would not bring a meaningful improvement, set "done": true. Do not resubmit near-identical widths.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"best":["your best design name(s) so far"],"done":false,"designs":[{"widths":[int px],"change":"what and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"d1r2A","good":"条款号保持完整，便于定位；修订后文本获得较多空间，三列仍能逐行对应。表格适配视口。","problems":"修订说明标题断成两行，正文与说明栏都很窄，词语被频繁拆开；各行很高，跨列对照需要大量纵向移动。","cause":"首列83px保住了完整条款号，但留给其余列的空间有限；原文79px、说明81px使阅读尺度偏窄，修订后116px也不足以避免大量断词。"},{"design":"d1r2B","good":"条款号完整，原文比d1r2A略宽，第一条的数据行也相应缩短；表格适配视口。","problems":"修订说明标题仍换行，后几条的行高明显增加，修订后文本尤其难以连续阅读；测得断词次数和总高度均为三者中最高。","cause":"将修订后列从116px缩至110px，换来原文列6px的增宽；较长的修订后内容因换行阈值变化而显著增高，说明列81px仍偏窄。"},{"design":"d1r1A","good":"四个列标题均保持一行；原文和修订后列的尺度较接近，整体高度和测得断词次数均为三者中最低，比较正文相对顺畅。表格适配视口。","problems":"条款号被拆成两行，削弱了首列的索引作用；正文和说明仍有大量密集短行，较长条款的跨列比较费力。","cause":"首列68px不足以容纳完整条款号，但释放出的空间让原文达到95px、修订后达到113px，并使说明列83px容纳完整标题。"}],"best":["d1r1A"],"done":false,"designs":[{"widths":[83,91,102,83],"change":"保留完整条款号和单行列标题，将剩余空间偏向两个比较列；检验索引完整与正文阅读之间的折中。"},{"widths":[83,79,114,83],"change":"保留完整条款号和单行标题，优先给最长的修订后文本空间；检验较窄原文是否仍能支持逐行对照。"},{"widths":[83,86,105,85],"change":"保留完整索引和标题，在正文两列与说明之间更均衡地分配空间；检验较宽说明列能否改善辅助阅读。"}]}
